title: werf.yaml
description:
werf configuration file. The file consists of several YAML documents separated by `---`: exactly one meta section (identified by `configVersion`) and any number of image sections (identified by `dockerfile` or `image`).
https://werf.io/docs/latest/reference/werf_yaml.html

scalarArray.description: Items are read as strings; a bare number or boolean is accepted as its literal text.

scalarMap.description: Values are read as strings; a bare number or boolean is accepted as its literal text.

cacheVersion.description: Cache version. Change it to invalidate the build cache.

regexpOrString.description: Exact value, or a regular expression enclosed in slashes: `/REGEXP/`.

secret.description:
Build secret. Exactly one of `env`, `src` or `value` must be set.
https://werf.io/docs/latest/usage/build/images.html#using-build-secrets

id.description: Secret unique identifier. Defaults to the environment variable name for `env` and to the file base name for `src`; mandatory for `value`.

env.description: A secret from an environment variable.

src.description: A secret from a file at the given path.

dependencyImportType.description: Type of image info to import.

from.description: Dependency image name, which should be built before building current image.

image.description: DEPRECATED. Use `from` instead. Dependency image name, which should be built before building current image.

dockerfileDependency.description: Dependency image whose info is passed into the Dockerfile build via build args.

imports.description: Target build args to import image information into current image.

targetBuildArg.description: Name of the build argument which will contain the specified type of information about the image.

stapelDependency.description: Dependency image whose info is passed into the Stapel build via environment variables. Exactly one of `before` or `after` must be set.

before.description: The stage before which image info should be imported. Target env variables are available at user stages after it.

after.description: The stage after which image info should be imported. Target env variables are available at user stages after it.

imports.description: Target environment variables to import image information into current image.

targetEnv.description: Name of the environment variable which will contain the specified type of information about the image.

imageSpecConfig.description: Image configuration according to the OCI specification.

keepEssentialWerfLabels.description: Do not remove werf labels necessary for normal operation.

clearWerfLabels.description: DEPRECATED. No longer has any effect.

removeLabels.description: List of labels to remove. Each item is an exact name or `/REGEXP/`.

removeEnv.description: List of environment variables to remove. Each item is an exact name or `/REGEXP/`.

healthcheck.description:
Healthcheck configuration. Intervals are in seconds.
https://docs.docker.com/engine/reference/builder/#healthcheck

test.description: Command to run, in exec form, for example ["CMD", "curl", "-f", "http://localhost/"].

timeout.description: Seconds a single check may take.

startperiod.description: UNDOCUMENTED. Seconds to wait after the container starts before running the first check.

retries.description: Consecutive failures needed to report unhealthy.

imageSpec.description:
Image configuration according to the OCI specification.
https://werf.io/docs/latest/usage/build/images.html#changing-image-configuration-spec

imageSpecGlobal.description:
Global image configuration options according to the OCI specification, applied to all final images.
https://werf.io/docs/latest/usage/build/images.html#changing-image-configuration-spec

keepEssentialWerfLabels.description: Do not remove werf labels necessary for normal operation.

clearWerfLabels.description: DEPRECATED. No longer has any effect.

removeLabels.description: List of labels to remove. Each item is an exact name or `/REGEXP/`.

last.description: Select the last n references. -1 means no limit.

in.description: Select git tags created during the period, or git branches active during the period.

operator.description: Whether both `last` and `in` must hold, or any of them.

meta.description: Meta section: project-wide settings. Exactly one per werf.yaml.

configVersion.description: Config syntax version. It should always be 1 for now.

project.description: Unique project name. Lower-case letters, digits and dashes; must not start or end with a dash.

platform.description: Common list of target platforms for all images (for example ['linux/amd64', 'linux/arm64', 'linux/arm/v8']).

staged.description: Enable layer-by-layer caching of Dockerfile instructions in container registry globally for all images.

helmChartDir.description: Path to the helm chart directory of the project.

cleanup.description:
Settings for cleaning up irrelevant images.
https://werf.io/docs/latest/usage/cleanup/cr_cleanup.html

disable.description: Disable cleanup entirely. This prevents meta images from being published to the container registry.

disableKubernetesBasedPolicy.description: Disable the policy that keeps images deployed in Kubernetes.

disableGitHistoryBasedPolicy.description: Disable the policy that keeps images according to user-defined `keepPolicies` based on the git history.

disableBuiltWithinLastNHoursPolicy.description: Disable the policy that keeps images built within the last `keepImagesBuiltWithinLastNHours` hours.

keepImagesBuiltWithinLastNHours.description: The minimum number of hours that must elapse since the image is built before it can be removed.

keepPolicies.description: Set of policies to select relevant image versions using the git history.

references.description: References to perform scanning on. Exactly one of `branch` or `tag` must be set.

branch.description: One or more git origin branches: an exact name or `/REGEXP/`.

tag.description: One or more git origin tags: an exact name or `/REGEXP/`.

limit.description: Rules to limit references by the date the git tag was created or the activity in the git branch.

imagesPerReference.description: The limit on the number of image versions for each reference contained in the set.

gitWorktree.description: Configure how werf handles the git worktree of the project.

forceShallowClone.description: Force werf to use shallow clone despite restrictions.

allowUnshallow.description: Allow werf to automatically convert the project shallow git clone to a full one during the build process when needed.

allowFetchOriginBranchesAndTags.description: Allow werf to synchronize git branches and tags with remote origin during the cleanup process when needed.

imageName.description: One or more unique names for the image.

final.description:
Mark the image as final. Intermediate images (`final: false`) are not published to the final repo and are not available in Helm templates.
https://werf.io/docs/latest/usage/build/images.html#using-intermediate-and-final-images

dockerfileImage.description:
Dockerfile image section: builds an image from a Dockerfile. Define as many as you need.
https://werf.io/docs/latest/usage/build/images.html

dockerfile.description: Dockerfile path relative to the context path.

staged.description: Enable layer-by-layer caching of Dockerfile instructions in container registry.

context.description: Build context path inside the project directory.

contextAddFiles.description: Untracked files and directories to add to the build context. Paths are relative to the context path.

contextAddFile.description: UNDOCUMENTED. Alias of `contextAddFiles`; the two cannot be used together.

platform.description: List of target platforms for this image (for example ['linux/amd64', 'linux/arm64', 'linux/arm/v8']).

target.description: Specific Dockerfile stage (the last one by default, similar to `docker build --target`).

args.description: Values for ARG Dockerfile instructions (similar to `docker build --build-arg`).

addHost.description: Custom host-to-IP mapping (host:ip), similar to `docker build --add-host`.

network.description: The networking mode for the RUN instructions during build (similar to `docker build --network`).

ssh.description:
DEPRECATED. SSH agent socket or keys for the build (similar to `docker build --ssh`).
https://werf.io/docs/latest/usage/build/images.html#using-build-secrets

secrets.description:
Secrets used in the image build.
https://werf.io/docs/latest/usage/build/images.html#using-build-secrets

dependencies.description: Dependency images for the current image.

gitMapping.description:
Adds source files from a git repository: the project repository (local, no `url`) or a remote one (`url`).
https://werf.io/docs/latest/usage/build/stapel/git.html

url.description:
The address of the remote repository. Omit to use the project repository.
https://werf.io/docs/latest/usage/build/stapel/git.html#working-with-remote-repositories

basicAuth.description: Basic authentication for the remote repository.

password.description: Password source. Exactly one of `env`, `src` or `value` must be set.

branch.description: The branch name. Remote repositories only.

tag.description: The tag name. Remote repositories only.

add.description:
A source path in the repository.
https://werf.io/docs/latest/usage/build/stapel/git.html#copying-directories

to.description:
A destination absolute path in the image.
https://werf.io/docs/latest/usage/build/stapel/git.html#copying-directories

owner.description:
The name or UID of the owner.
https://werf.io/docs/latest/usage/build/stapel/git.html#changing-the-owner

group.description:
The name or GID of the owner's group.
https://werf.io/docs/latest/usage/build/stapel/git.html#changing-the-owner

stageDependencies.description:
Re-run assembly instructions of a stage when the matching files change in the git repository.
https://werf.io/docs/latest/usage/build/stapel/instructions.html#dependency-on-changes-in-the-git-repo

shell.description:
Shell assembly instructions, grouped by user stage.
https://werf.io/docs/latest/usage/build/stapel/instructions.html#shell

cacheVersion.description:
Common cache version for all user stages.
https://werf.io/docs/latest/usage/build/stapel/instructions.html#dependency-on-the-cacheversion

beforeInstallCacheVersion.description: Cache version for the beforeInstall stage.

installCacheVersion.description: Cache version for the install stage.

beforeSetupCacheVersion.description: Cache version for the beforeSetup stage.

setupCacheVersion.description: Cache version for the setup stage.

mount.description:
Mount point. Set either `from` (a werf service directory) or `fromPath` (an arbitrary host path).
https://werf.io/docs/latest/usage/build/stapel/mounts.html

from.description: Service directory: `tmp_dir` lives for one build, `build_dir` persists between builds of the project.

fromPath.description: Absolute or relative path to an arbitrary file or directory on the host.

import.description:
Copies files from another image at a user stage boundary. Exactly one of `before` or `after` must be set.
https://werf.io/docs/latest/usage/build/stapel/imports.html

from.description: The source image: another image from werf.yaml (e.g. `backend`) or an external image with a tag/digest (e.g. `nginx:1.25`, `nginx@sha256:...`).

image.description: DEPRECATED. Use `from` instead. The source image name.

before.description: The stage before which to import files.

after.description: The stage after which to import files.

add.description: The absolute file or directory path in the source image to copy.

to.description: The absolute path in the destination image. Defaults to `add`.

owner.description: The name or UID of the owner.

group.description: The name or GID of the owner's group.

stapelImage.description:
Stapel image section: builds an image with werf's own assembly instructions. Define as many as you need.
https://werf.io/docs/latest/usage/build/stapel/base.html

platform.description: List of target platforms for this image (for example ['linux/amd64', 'linux/arm64', 'linux/arm/v8']).

from.description:
The base image: another image from werf.yaml (e.g. `backend`), an external image with a tag/digest (e.g. `nginx:1.25`, `nginx@sha256:...`), or `scratch`.
https://werf.io/docs/latest/usage/build/stapel/base.html#from

fromImage.description: DEPRECATED. Use `from` instead. The base image name.

fromLatest.description:
Use the actual base image without caching. Not compatible with `from: scratch`.
https://werf.io/docs/latest/usage/build/stapel/base.html#from

fromCacheVersion.description:
Cache version of the base image stage.
https://werf.io/docs/latest/usage/build/stapel/base.html#fromcacheversion

git.description:
Set of directives to add source files from git repositories (both the project repository and any other).
https://werf.io/docs/latest/usage/build/stapel/git.html

dependencies.description: Dependency images for the current image.

network.description: The networking mode for the assembly containers.

secrets.description:
Secrets used in the image build.
https://werf.io/docs/latest/usage/build/stapel/instructions.html#using-build-secrets
